request.prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural. One real photograph for a Spanish-speaking adult beginner learning English. Full-bleed 3:2 landscape; no frames, padding, watermark or captions. The only writing is the price card.

This is a precise edit of image 1: the result must look like the same photograph with one detail changed. Change only what the instruction names.

Image 1 shows a red book on a market counter beside a white price card that reads $1. Keep the photograph exactly as it is: the same book, counter, background, light and framing, and the same white card in the same place. Change ONLY the writing on the price card: erase the 1 and write 70, so that the card reads exactly $70 in the same black marker handwriting, large and sharp, with every digit fully inside the card. Nothing else changes.
